description: President Donald Trump hosted Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at the White House for a private dinner Sunday night. Amodei has been pushing for an industry-wide slowdown and warning that rapid AI development poses a significant risk, while Trump says he’s not worried about AI going rogue. Their dinner comes ahead of a key White House summit with some of the industry’s other top executives. NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.
title: Trump Meets With Anthropic CEO Ahead of Key AI Summit
